content:
Details of the Funding Round

Generative Bionics, a subsidiary of the Italian Institute of Technology, raised 70 million euros in a funding round led by CDP Venture Capital’s Artificial Intelligence Fund. In addition to Tether, the issuer of USDT, strategic partners such as AMD Ventures, Duferco, Eni Next, and RoboIT participated in the round.

Technological Goals and Production Plan

The company will use the funding to develop physical AI systems and establish a dedicated production facility. The main sectors of focus are:

  • Logistics automation
  • Healthcare technologies
  • Industrial production

Generative Bionics is working on systems that combine humanoid robotics with artificial intelligence. The company aims to unveil its first commercial robot at the CES 2026 trade show in Las Vegas.

R&D History and Market Expectations

The startup, which currently has 60 humanoid robot prototypes, has been conducting R&D activities for over 20 years with a team of 70 engineers and scientists. Tether CEO Paolo Ardoino highlighted that humanoid robotics strengthens both digital and physical infrastructure, noting that this technology represents the evolution of intelligence and capabilities in the real world.

The global humanoid robotics market is projected to exceed 200 billion euros by 2035 and 5 trillion euros by 2050, driven by the widespread adoption of industrial automation.
